decisions.reason: A coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management offer and fits its push toward higher-pressure, efficient machining, so dropping it after one year is unlikely.
A coolant cleaning centrifuge supports the firm's filtration and sustainability positioning and complements its existing systems.
A coolant nozzle line is a low-cost accessory range that cross-sells with pumps and boosters, so keeping it costs little.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's core conveying business for metalworking customers.
Magnetic belt chip conveyors fill a standard niche in the chip conveyor portfolio and serve established customer needs.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are among the most common conveyor types and central to the firm's established offer.
